items.title: 3 Industrial Dividend Stocks With Cash Flow Strength in Higher Rates
items.summary: Rates are climbing in slow motion, inflation is still sticky and safer income now competes head on with equities. That mix is punishing stretched stories but can reward solid dividend payers that do not rely on cheap money to survive. This piece walks through three high quality, income focused stocks exposed to this higher for longer rate backdrop and explains where the current pressure might create long term opportunity or signal caution. items.title: Trane Technologies (TT) Commits $1 Million To Clean Tech Workforce Training
items.summary: Trane Technologies (NYSE:TT) agreed to a three-year, US$1 million grant with Goodwill Industries to expand the Clean Tech Accelerator workforce program. The partnership aims to grow clean technology training capacity for skilled trades that support the clean energy economy. Goodwill Industries plans to use the funding to reach more participants through expanded training, career services, and employer connections.
